# SD13-E2 deterministic Halfling Fighter level 1 race-semantics recognition
# fixture. Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Halfling Fighter level 1
# identity as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. The ability scores already reflect the
# fixed PF1 Core Halfling +2 Dexterity / -2 Strength racial adjustment
# (recognition-only on the compute seam, not arithmetic performed there).
#
# The Fighter combat baseline, total saves, and selected-skill modifiers stay
# claim-blocked on this input because the bounded GE-06 Fighter compute path is
# grounded only for race:human; that is expected and unrelated to this fixture's
# purpose, which is to make the bounded Halfling race-semantics recognition
# legible. It deliberately avoids every unproven Halfling family: no racial
# bonus feat (PF1 core Halflings gain none), no Fearless, no Halfling Luck, no
# Keen Senses Perception bonus, no Sure-Footed Acrobatics/Climb bonus, and no
# weapon familiarity grant.
case_id=pf1-crb-halfling-fighter-level1
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:halfling
class_level=class:fighter:1
